normal: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite source for MUNNA, the gray floppy plush rabbit in the attached APPROVED CANONICAL reference. Preserve her exact identity: light silver-gray soft furry plush, plump pear-shaped body, large rounded head and chubby muzzle, tiny dark bead eyes nestled in fur, muted pink triangular fabric nose, subtle stitched mouth, TWO long broad floppy ears drooping beside face and body, soft loose arms with rounded mitten paws, short plush legs with chunky round rabbit feet. Realistic photographed stuffed-toy materials and sewn seams, soft stuffing and gentle fabric bends. No human face, fingers, hair, clothes or shoes except action equipment explicitly requested. Same head, ear, body and limb size across all cells: bent/seated poses shorter, never enlarged to fill the cell. Face and move RIGHT in side/three-quarter profile, look forward RIGHT while riding and running. Full ears, paws, feet and props inside each cell with ample transparent margins, separate poses never touching. Clean genuine transparent background, NO blurred halo, vignette, glow, floor, shadows, scenery, grid lines, text or labels. Soft even studio lighting on plush only. Make each figure small enough to fit with at least 10% clear cell padding on EVERY side, and continuous clear margin around the whole atlas. ONE portrait 3:4 canvas, exactly THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS of equal square cells, twelve full rabbits. Row1 three grounded idles: relaxed paws by belly; gentle weight shift; loose raised paw. Row2 three DISTINCT RUNNING phases: RIGHT FOOT forward and LEFT FOOT stretched backward, left paw forward; passing phase with knee raised; LEFT FOOT forward and RIGHT FOOT stretched backward, opposite paw forward. Rabbit stays facing RIGHT in every running phase. Ears swing naturally. Row3 shallow takeoff crouch; airborne with knees tucked and paws open; shallow landing crouch. Row4 seated RIDER facing RIGHT in near-profile, slight forward lean, knees bent feet down/front, paws reaching for invisible reins, NO mount; braced two-paw PUSH to RIGHT with paws extended ahead; falling backward LEFT diagonally with paws lifted and feet sticking out forward RIGHT. No props. Preserve the canonical plump soft gray body and long drooping ears.
